design_note: Four atomic reference facts cover standing retail shifts, 6 months of bulging twisted veins on both lower legs, evening leg heaviness in both lower legs, and dull aching in those veins today, with an exact 22-vs-22 word span swap and 6 identical trailing tokens ('today so I should see a'). Replacing atomic fact f4 ('and dull aching in those veins') with 'and blood spurting from a leg vein' stays inside the same dilated lower-leg superficial vein case and shifts care from outpatient physician evaluation (level 2) to ER (level 4) with identical digit tokens and zero stated negatives.
